test_pickle_simple_callable: test pickling a simple callable function and verify it returns the expected value after deserialization
test_roundtrip_pickleable: test roundtrip pickling of Pickleable and PickleableNew classes with extra attributes using pickle protocol 2
test_roundtrip_with_dict: test roundtrip pickling of PickleableWithDict classes that support dynamic attribute storage via __dict__
test_enum_pickle: test pickling and unpickling of pybind11 enum values to verify enum roundtrip correctness
test_roundtrip_simple_py_derived: test pickling a Python-derived class extending SimpleBase and verify attributes survive serialization
